Home.badge: Enterprise MCP server · Operated in the EU
Home.heroBody: The company governs who can do what with company data. The team connects Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible client they already work in.
Home.featureMcpBody: Not another chatbot. An MCP server you connect to Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or any MCP client. The team keeps working where they already work.
Home.featureAccessBody: You decide which agent can access what. Sensitive writes wait for a human before anything goes out.
Home.featureAuditBody: Every tool call is logged: who asked for what, which data was touched, what went out. You can review it later.
Home.featureAdminBody: The company administrator sets agents, connectors, roles, and autonomy. Only what you publish is live on MCP.
Home.featureModelsBody: Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok — the team uses what already works. Control stays on the company MCP.
Home.howStep1Body: Agents, connectors, permissions, approval rules. Once, in the admin surface.
Home.howStep2Body: One tenant MCP URL. Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or any MCP client — the same server.
Home.howStep3Title: A human decides at the sensitive points
Home.howStep3Body: File writes, folder creation, outbound actions: an approval card, one click.
Home.aboutBody: Excellence AI is operated by Excellence Pay Kft. The platform is an enterprise MCP server: the company manages agents, connectors, and permissions, and employees work in company systems through their own AI tools. Connecting external accounts is always optional, and the details are in the privacy notice.
Home.aboutCardLead: <brand>Excellence AI</brand> is an enterprise MCP server operated by Excellence Pay Kft. It helps organizations give any MCP-compatible AI governed access to company tools — under access control, audit logging, privacy safeguards, and human approval.
Home.aboutCardRest: The product is not a public consumer chatbot. It is a signed-in workspace where invited company members work through their own AI clients on a governed MCP. External account connections are always optional and described in detail in the privacy documents. See the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms</terms>.
Home.ctaTitle: Connect your company’s AI to your own MCP.
Home.ctaBody: A closed, invitation-only workspace. Sign in and set up the first tenant MCP.
